def: Of adamant; hard as adamant. Milton.
The eliminant of the n partial differentials of any homogenousfunction of n variables. See Eliminant.
Of or pertaining to the German physicist Wilhelm KonradRöntgen, or the rays discovered by him; as, Röntgen apparatus.
The foramen or passage through the inner integument of anovule.
In a definite manner; with precision; precisely; determinately.
Able and apt to invent; quick at contrivance; ready atexpedients; as, an inventive head or genius. Dryden.-- In*vent"ive*ly, adv.-- In*vent"ive*ness, n.
Bent backward angularly, as if half-broken; as, a refractedstem or leaf.
To open or undo, as what is wrapped or folded. Chaucer.
